import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = map(int, data[1:1 + n]) if n > 0 else []
    total = sum(x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0)
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
